## Historical audit — S0233

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_v2_1/results/r1/fixed_h0/H0/development/commons_187101683/trajectory.jsonl`. Citations below refer to its JSONL lines and supplied character ranges.

| Evidence | Observation |
|---|---|
| Student request, line 1 [0,5619) | The explicit goal was a separate-mesh indoor reconstruction from one RGB image, matching viewpoint and framing, without using the image as a texture or background. The student’s object names suggest an inferred living-room interpretation; they do not independently establish what the reference depicts. |
| Student response and execute, lines 3 [0,11398), 4 [0,12045) | The program constructed multiple objects: wall, carpet, sofa parts and tilted pillows, table, two cup-and-saucer assemblies, napkins, flowerpot and flowers, and curtains. It grouped components and positioned them, but grouping or intended contact does not verify physical connections. It specified colors, procedural bump and sheen, camera, lights and render settings; their visual fidelity is unverified. |
| Execution result and next request, lines 5 [0,1992), 6 [0,18956) | Step 1 failed before producing an image: `scene.world` was `None` at `world.use_nodes`. The student received the traceback, not a rendered view, despite the request to compare views. |
| Student revision and execution, lines 8 [0,11945), 9 [0,12590) | The revised complete program creates and assigns a world if absent. It also changes the lens from 49 to 63 and camera target height from 1.00 to 1.08. These are observed edits, not evidence that framing improved. |
| Result, selection and review, lines 10 [0,107891), 11 [0,59), 12 [0,139595), 14 [0,342) | Step 2 reported `ok: true`, saved a render and blend file, and was selected. The next request supplied both image paths with no executions remaining; the student replied `DONE`. The log shows 16 render samples although the program requested 48. No independent image or geometry inspection is available in this audit. |

**Teacher and autonomy.** No teacher message, detection, diagnosis, proposed update, or teacher-driven execution appears in this student trace; therefore teacher receipt or adoption is not evidenced. The student independently produced the initial program and revised it after runner feedback. The recorded sessions report zero tool calls (lines 2, 7 and 13); no broader exploration is visible.

**Outcome and uncertainty.** This is a technical recovery followed by a successful build/render and selection, not an empty patch. Formal visual or geometric correctness remains **unknown**, not established by `ok` or `DONE`. In particular, object count in the code, part contact, pillow pose, material appearance, camera framing and lighting cannot be checked against the unseen images. Whether the changed lens improved the match and why the effective sample count differed remain unresolved hypotheses.

**Transferable lesson:** runner errors can identify initialization failures independently of scene quality; a successful rerun validates execution, not reconstruction fidelity. **Task-specific detail:** the missing Blender world and the particular living-room object layout are observations of this attempt, not general findings.
